summary: I had the pleasure of seeing Toots and the Maytals perform many times across this country and in Negril, but no memories more fun than the sweat packed nastiness of New Haven's Toad's Place...Such a cesspool of a venue..I love it.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I had the pleasure of seeing Toots and the Maytals perform many times across this country and in Negril, but no memories more fun than the sweat packed nastiness of New Haven's Toad's Place...Such a cesspool of a venue..I love it.
